name: UniformRootedTree
title: Uniform unrooted tree with a randomly chosen root

args.name: branchLengthDist
args.description: The distribution used independently for each branch length

description: Choose a labelled unrooted binary topology uniformly, draw independent branch lengths from branchLengthDist, and choose the root uniformly among all existing nodes, including tips. Standalone density evaluation with pdf is currently unavailable.
